affected_version: Exact published 0.5.2 tarball has the same existsSync/readFileSync/split validator. Candidate reproduced before patch; earlier releases unassessed.
decision: Nick approved configurable bounded streaming on 2026-09-08: explicit errors, preserved history, no automatic rotation/deletion.
invariant: Repository-controlled event histories are contained regular files and cannot cause unbounded byte, line, record or diagnostic consumption during CLI, MCP or materialization validation. Existing event bytes and permissive record semantics remain unchanged.
strategy: Shared incremental event validator; contained nonblocking/no-follow regular-file streaming in <=64KiB chunks; actual-byte accounting; optional normalized events.validation limits with finite hard ceilings; aggregate event/Markdown budget.

review: Reused completed independent prepatch investigation; one fresh independent candidate reviewer found no additional static-input bypass or parser regression. Parent confirmed the reported concurrent ancestor-swap route using owned disposable directories and intercepted openSync. It consumed 16 external fixture bytes, still within configured finite resource bounds. This is the pre-existing shared path-authority race limitation requiring another active local filesystem writer; not a static repository-input resource bypass. No claim of race immunity or final platform/security clearance; task-828 must independently review the limitation and public compatibility statements.
